description: Before you open a debate (from 26 November 2026): upload your working document, a Word file in the template's layout (/notes/template) meeting the document standard: a Word file with six sections (Summary, Question, Background, Evidence and argument, Limitations, References), 600 to 6,000 words, one to twenty sources each matching its record, every source cited as [n], every quotation and figure found in its source. Every miss comes back with its fix; nothing is stored until it passes. Then open the debate with note set to the slug returned.

sources.description: The References list, in the order of their numbers [1], [2]...
